To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the UV/IR problem of field theories on noncommutative spaces with translation invariant products is cured at the quantum level by the introduction of quantum corrections in the action.

(i) the quantum corrections of translation-invariant noncommutative models can be used to cure the mixing; (ii) the UV/IR behavior of the theory can be improved; (iii) the quantum corrections are independent of the noncommutativity scale.

(i) we propose a new method to cure the UV-IR mixing for field theory with translation-invariant noncommutativity, (ii) we show that the UV-IR problem can be solved by taking into account the quantum correction of the model, (iii) we compute the form for the action in the matrix basis for the Wick-Vorsos product, (iv) we calculate one loop and higher loop Feynman diagrams.
